ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels centrally and 25% low-intensity black pixels concentrated along the trailing edge and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central lobes. Irregular, jagged low-intensity black bands form a continuous border along the trailing edge and outer tips. Low-intensity black mottling radiates outward from the median notch in a feathering pattern. Discrete low-intensity spots are scattered across the interior high-intensity white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex and an approximate pixel-calculated angle between 45 and 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks) are observed on the medial and distal portions of the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature along the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips, transitioning to convex leading edges partially obscured by water turbulence.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of several circular high-contrast pixel clusters on the high-intensity white field, including three distinct raised white circular bumps on the right lobe and one prominent dark circular spot on the inner right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular chipping and small notch-like losses of tissue along the trailing edge boundary of both lobes; distinct low-intensity pigmentation spots on the inner white surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique feather-like black pigmentation transition radiating from the median notch into the white central fluke area.
